title: Coefficient changes commute with $\alpha_f$
statement:
Let $a\colon\Lambda\to\Lambda'$ be a morphism of condensed rings, that is, a morphism of ring objects in condensed abelian groups ([sk-def-sfb-condensed-ring]), and let $f\colon X\to Y$ be a morphism of schemes. Let $\Lambda_X,\Lambda_Y,\Lambda'_X,\Lambda'_Y$ be the pulled-back coefficient ring objects of [sk-def-sfb-pulled-back-coefficients]. Write $f^*$ for the pullback of abelian pro-étale sheaves defined by [def-sfb-finite-upper-star] with $\mathcal A=\Ab$. Let
$$
\alpha_f\colon f^*\Lambda_Y\longrightarrow\Lambda_X,\qquad
\alpha'_f\colon f^*\Lambda'_Y\longrightarrow\Lambda'_X
$$
be the coefficient ring-object morphisms of [sk-def-sfb-coefficient-morphisms], and let
$$
a_X\colon\Lambda_X\longrightarrow\Lambda'_X,\qquad
a_Y\colon\Lambda_Y\longrightarrow\Lambda'_Y
$$
be the coefficient changes of [def-sfb-coefficient-map]. Then, on the underlying abelian sheaves,
$$
\alpha'_f\circ f^*a_Y=a_X\circ\alpha_f\colon f^*\Lambda_Y\longrightarrow\Lambda'_X.
$$
